question: If △PQR is right angled at Q, then what is the value of cos (P + R)?
solution:
**Given:**

△PQR is right angled at Q.

**Concept Used:**

Angle sum property = Sum of all the angles of the triangle is 180° .

**Calculation:**

△PQR is right angled at Q.

Value of P + R = 180° - ∠Q

⇒ 180° - 90° 

⇒ 90° 

cos (P + R) = cos 90° 

⇒ cos (P + R) = 0

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
